displayName: automate applying to jobs with email
description: Automated job searching assistant. Searches for jobs on LinkedIn, Indeed, Glassdoor, Wellfound, Agentur für Arbeit, and direct URLs, composes personalised application emails with CV attached, sends via Gmail SMTP, and maintains a JSON tracker. Use when: apply to jobs, find jobs, job search, check tracker, update application, send application email, or check inbox for job replies and more..
